name: PharmAgent
description: PharmAgent is an OpenClaw-backed clinical pharmacy assistant that stages guideline-derived JSON-LD/RDF into DKG v10 Shared Memory and drafts evidence-grounded French chart notes from retrieved context.

install.oneLiner: Clone the repository, authenticate OpenClaw, validate JSON-LD, then stage PharmAgent sources to DKG shared memory.

networkEgress: api.openai.com or operator-configured OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint when a user-provided key is used
OpenClaw OAuth provider configured by the operator
writeAuthority: SHARE guideline-derived JSON-LD/RDF triples via local DKG/OpenClaw daemon
optional PUBLISH via local DKG/OpenClaw daemon only when curator review enables verified-memory promotion
security.notes: PharmAgent uses the operator's local OpenClaw OAuth session by default and can optionally call an operator-provided OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The integration does not commit or distribute local DKG tokens, OpenClaw credentials, API keys, embeddings, or runtime logs. Clinical JSON-LD excerpts are marked needsHumanReview=true and reviewStatus=human_review; unsupported cases refuse without LLM guessing. The app touches curator-authority publish only when the operator explicitly runs the staging script with --publish or DKG_PUBLISH=1.

promotionPath: PharmAgent writes parsed guideline excerpts into Working/Shared Memory first, with every clinical source entity marked for human review. Curators can promote reviewed guideline assets toward Verified Memory using the explicit --publish path once clinical review and DKG publish approval are complete. The four-section note output is shaped for downstream clinical context oracles by keeping patient facts, analysis, recommendation, and cited sources separate.
fitNotes: PharmAgent applies the LLM-wiki/autoresearch pattern to clinical pharmacy: source documents become structured JSON-LD/RDF memory, multiple cases retrieve and reuse that shared evidence, and the agent refuses to answer when its local knowledge substrate lacks support.
